name: Cindy Ping
description: Give the cat a poke to ping Cindy. What you’re looking at and what you want done go along with it, and Cindy takes it from there. Currently supports macOS 14+ only.
whenToUse: Desktop emotes, configurable reactions, window context collection, and tasks triggered by an emote.

status.description: Read wheel, capture-permission and delivery status. macOS 14+. Emotes can create a project task, add context to an existing task or send to a companion, with per-trigger selection or a fixed target. Requires cindy.targets support; legacy plugin-task bindings are retained. Actions can incur model costs and attach screenshots through Cindy managed media; no conversation history is returned. Window material is attached separately from instructions; new conversations use Cindy automatic titles.

get_config.description: Read the current Cindy Ping configuration and revision before editing. Preserve fields the user did not ask to change.

configure.description: Configure the wheel, emotes, actions, destinations, instructions, models, permissions, delivery and shortcut. Read get_config; edit only requested fields in the full config and submit its revision. STALE_REVISION requires re-reading. Use list_targets/list_models for exact IDs. Only new conversations use route/permissionMode; explicit permissions need host createPermissionMode. Existing conversations and companions keep their settings. recent offers up to three active targets, single-select, without pagination. promptMode preset uses saved text without input. Only input opens a blank single-line bar after capture. It survives the 2s emote fade. Repeated input triggers reuse the bar and unfinished text; only the latest action/capture can send. Enter confirms; Esc cancels. Sending/cancelling clears text; per-use text is never saved. Display-only opens no input and captures nothing. Saving configuration never displays, captures or sends anything.

list_targets.description: List available projects, conversations or companions with exact kind/id and display metadata, in host activity order. No conversation history.

list_models.description: List available models and complete routes, reasoning efforts and Fast support.
